verses.text: A psalm by Asaph. God really is good to Israel, to those whose hearts are pure.
Me? I almost lost my footing. One more step and I would’ve slipped.
I envied the arrogant when I saw how well the wicked had it.
They don’t struggle when death comes. Their strength holds up.
They don’t carry the burdens other people do. The troubles that hit everyone else seem to pass them by.
So they wear pride like a necklace and violence like an outfit.
Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds run wild with conceit.
They mock people and talk with malice. They throw their weight around and threaten to crush others.
They aim their mouths at heaven, and their tongues roam the whole earth.
So their people keep coming back to them and drink it all in like water.
They say, “How would God know? Does the Most High even know what’s going on?”
Look at the wicked. They’re always taking it easy, and their wealth keeps piling up.
Was all that work to keep my heart clean and my hands innocent for nothing?
Trouble hits me all day long, and every morning feels like another punishment.
If I’d said, “I’m going to talk like them,” I would’ve betrayed a whole generation of your children.
I tried to make sense of it, but it hurt too much to think about
until I stepped into God’s sanctuary and saw where their road ends.
You really do set them on slippery ground. You send them crashing into ruin.
Just like that, they’re destroyed, swept away in terror.
They’re like a dream when someone wakes up. When you rise, Lord, you’ll treat their illusions with contempt.
My soul was hurting, and bitterness had settled deep in my heart.
I was clueless and didn’t understand. Before you, I was acting like a wild animal.
And still, I’m here with you. You’ve got hold of my right hand.
You’ll guide me with your counsel, then welcome me into glory.
Who else do I have in heaven? There’s no one on earth I want more than you.
My body and my heart may give out, but God is the strength of my heart and my share forever.
Anyone who stays far from you will perish. You destroy everyone who turns away from you in unfaithfulness.
As for me, being close to God is good. I’ve made the Lord GOD my safe place so I can tell people everything you’ve done.
